insights.headline: Close the highest-signal senior skill gaps
insights.body: These terms appear in multiple senior-or-higher postings but are not listed in the public profile strengths. Treat them as portfolio proof points only if they are genuinely true.

insights.headline: Prioritise companies building a design bench
insights.body: Multiple open design roles at the same company are a stronger application signal than a single isolated posting.

insights.headline: Do not anchor Indian negotiation on foreign salary bands
insights.body: Indian employers in this crawl published too few senior pay bands to report honestly (n=0). Foreign and remote postings disclose more (n=9), with a median INR-converted midpoint of ₹13,772,000, but that is context only because it crosses currencies, tax regimes and visa constraints.

india.note: Reportable only with at least 3 disclosed India-based postings.

foreign_remote_context.market: Foreign and remote postings, INR-converted for context only
foreign_remote_context.note: Do not use this as an Indian negotiation anchor; it mixes employer countries, tax systems and visa access.

insights.headline: Trend calls need more committed history
insights.body: Today has been snapshotted, but there is not enough 7-day history yet to claim the market is heating or cooling.
